what: MOXIR v7: v6 (100) + 20 red/amber scenes named by content (owner 01:2x)
source: docs/moxir/scenes-v6-2026-10-18/scenes_v6.py from scripts/place/rigs/moxir-scenes-100-v5-2026-10-18.json (schema, palette, the cube net by colour)
licence: di.iiii project data (the owner's); MOXIR teaser frames used as reference only, never published

rules.floor: line L + line R lit in the scene's family colour like every wash (owner 12:0x); the v3 "floor never red" rule is withdrawn by that word
rules.flash: worst 1 s per lamp <= 3 flashes (WCAG 2.x flash definition, measured on fx.js)

eye_v3.no_saturated_blue_or_violet_lamps: linear B share >= 0.8 banned on every lamp (lasers excepted)
eye_v3.method: palette.py eye(); thresholds are taste, unvalidated

rules.beam_colours: v2.2: open, red-orange, lime only (owner 20:1x: lime, not regular colours)
rules.lasers: the laser session's current design (v5: whole field, levels 1.0) unchanged; updated later by the laser work, when ready
rules.wash_colours: v2.2: ember #ff3a12, lime #9cff00, white #ffffff only (lead 20:15); beams open #ffffff, red-orange #ff5a1e, lime #8cff3a only; no other colour
rules.family: one colour family per scene (+ white at <= 0.1 in a colour scene); red and green never together (R4, R5)
rules.laser40: the 40 W lines are a layer: laser40 per scene, laser_lines null unless --laser40 on (owner 12:0x: enough); graphics never 74,75,78,79,166,167,246-253
rules.levels: full power: every part lit at 1.0 in every scene (owner 2026-10-18 00:5x "full use all lights all lasers")

colour_mix.method: share of lamp-level-seconds: level x number of lamps in the part (rig v2.10; outside re-parted as outside_rule.py) x (fade + hold), summed per colour over the 50 scenes

scenes_with_red_inside_per_act.rule: saturated red (WCAG 2.2 R share >= 0.8, linear) or hue within 15 deg of red at S >= 0.6, any inside part; the owner-set entrance is outside and not counted

scenes.intent: All 37 lamps white; a comet runs from the door to the DJ (66 bpm); the 18 beams ride wide circles mirrored left/right, 170° wide, every 8 bars, cutting just over your head; cubes: #eefdfd net; 40 W: slow turn + small wave.
